preinspection_disclosure: The original search snippets and bibliographic metadata for Rios–Saban–Zheng (2023) and Rios–Torrico (2023 and later version) WERE SEEN before this preregistration. The source discovery is exploratory. This preregistration freezes ONLY the follow-up detailed original-document inspection/eligibility and adversarial novelty comparison; NOT scientific confirmation of an emergent mechanism or a preregistered literature discovery.

A.question: Do real original platform observational and quasi-experimental studies already implement exposure-conditioned two-sided recommendations with reciprocal like decisions, times, and causal design, making an ESBM algorithmic effect/reputation/history novelty claim scientifically preempted?
A.unit: Original field study, study dataset accessibility and its identification strategy; no respondent-level original data available locally.
A.population: Only participants/platform examined in source papers, not Spain/Tinder extrapolation.
A.treatment: Study's own recommendation/assortment changes if verifiably implemented; the target of this cycle is DOCUMENTARY class of identification.
A.comparison: Published original baseline designs, pre/post or quasi-experimental comparator (if verifiable), and independent alternative Chen 2023 and Topinkova 2025 from existing ledger.
A.outcome: Documented historical precedence, measurement eligibility, scope and strength of identification; no own causal effect outcome
A.harm: Avoid disclosing raw app participants, extracting identifiers or treating proprietary datasets as downloadable.

B.H1: Original primary papers document actually observed displayed profiles plus time-stamped bilateral evaluations and independent intervention or quasi-experiment; strong prior art to core ESBM opportunity-ranking mechanism.
B.H0: Sources only present theoretical optimization and simulations fitted to proprietary covariates, no intervention or actual exposure data; thus comparison to ESBM must remain limited.
B.H_alt: A quasi-experiment exists but neither randomization nor user equilibrium interference identifies global causal benefit; or source published after prior related paper rather than new independent cohort.

C.discriminating_gate: Inspect ORIGINAL full text, methods/data & timing, exact unit/fields, quasi-experiment estimator and assumptions, benchmark details and whether datasets/downloadable rights exist. Verify earlier pre-2026 publication and actual DOI. Only count cycle valid if original evidence genuinely distinguishes models or directly establishes near-identical prior art; do not count a mere search or duplicate catalog.
controls: Strongest baseline prior art Chen et al. (2023) matching recommendations and Hitsch et al. (2010) browsing
Alternative selection/confounding and interference explanations for quasi-experiment
Compare same outcome (match vs sustained relationship) and opportunity sets; no claims about wellbeing
Classify simulation-with-real-fitted-parameters vs field actual evaluated intervention

planned_sources: Improving Match Rates in Dating Markets Through Assortment Optimization, Rios, Saban, Zheng (2023)
Platform Design in Curated Dating Markets, Rios and Torrico (2023/updated); original arXiv/PDF
Reference baseline Chen et al. 2023 as prior source SRC032
D.instrument: Inspect original PDF with screenshot to validate tables and claims; extract metadata only and identify any original raw-data access/license. No raw simulation.

prelisted_failures: Industry partner proprietary data not accessible
History effects imported from other paper, not tested causally
Counterfactual simulation does not equal field treatment effect
Quasi-experiment potential confounding and temporal interference
Data from same partner/study not independent replication
Strong publication novelty bar: compare 2023, not current drafts only

G.independent_replication: NOT_PLANNED; this is literature inspection, not our empirical replication

H.rule: Before/after qualitative prior ledger updates OR NO_CHANGE_WITH_REASON; record identical datasets once; no numeric prior.

I.grade: 0/3 baseline; any result only documentary, cannot merit own 2/3

decision_rules: If original full empirical methods/observations genuinely discriminating and auditable: complete N79 documentary A–J, decrement to 7 slots, retain STOP if data inaccessible
If inaccessible/inadequate: archive exploration as POST_HOC_SOURCE_AUDIT, do not consume N79

DRIFT.justification: Same theory and estimand family, new independently documented source/instrument and stronger platform baseline
